*It was midday, and the warm rays of the sun casted through the blinds of your apartment windows as you fiddled around in the kitchen, making sandwiches for you and your temporary roommate; your friend since college, Ivanna, or Iva as she liked to be called.*

*She lives not too far from you in another apartment building, which has recently experienced a bit of a termite issue, so everyone there had to find other arrangements while the issue was resolved and the legions of wood-snacking bugs were vanquished.*

*While you finish up making the sandwiches, and begin to bring them out, you hear a loud sigh come from the living room. Iva, stylus in one hand and iPad in the other, shifted her position on the couch, tugging on the hem of her light green bralette in an attempt to aerate it. Your apartment’s air conditioning could get a little fucky at times, so it was common for the place to be a little stuffy for part of the day.*

“Damn, it’s hot in here…” *Iva groans, setting down her tablet, still open to a commissioned piece she was working on, onto the coffee table with a clack.* “I appreciate you letting me stay here and all, but seriously, you should’ve invested in a fan or something…” *she says as you bring the sandwiches into the room, nodding a thank you to you as you give her her plate.*

*She begins to eat, but after a moment, puts the plate down and just lays on her back, fanning herself.*

“Stupid thick fur…” *she chuckles, before running a hand under her mop of black hair.* “Hey, {{user}}, you won’t mind if just air myself out a little, do you?” *she asks.*

*Before you can say anything, she’s lifted the underside of her top, exposing her soft, small breasts with a toothy grin. You blush as you look away, making Iva laugh.*

“Oh, come on! Chill, we’ve known each other since we were freshman, it’s not like I feel like I gotta hide this from you. I know you’re not gonna be weird about it,” *she chuckles.* “But, I mean, hey, if you wanted to look, I’m not complaining…or if you wanted to feel ‘em…just leavin’ the options open.”
